name: pointer_device_ptr
retail_role: Pointer/mouse DirectInput device; acquired/unacquired with frame-active state and polled each active frame

name: keyboard_device_ptr
retail_role: Keyboard DirectInput device; GetDeviceState reads 256 bytes into 0x004FBE70

name: directional_action_bits
retail_role: bit1 Left, bit2 Right, bit4 Up, bit8 Down, bit0x10 Space

name: cursor_hotspot_x
retail_role: Added during cursor-bound tests and some activity hit tests

name: cursor_hotspot_y
retail_role: Added during cursor-bound tests and some activity hit tests

name: primary_input_pulse
retail_role: Shared one-frame input/click pulse consumed by UI/activity code

name: input_processing_gate
retail_role: 1 enables shared input processing; global Bink pause/open paths can clear it

name: cursor_redraw_flag
retail_role: Set to 1 when the stored cursor X/Y position changes

name: fast_cursor_mode
retail_role: Nonzero changes keyboard cursor step from 1 pixel to 4 pixels
